substeps.caption: The door unlocks and swings open on its right-hand hinge, showing the 150 mm vertical goniometer.
A powder sample on its holder goes onto the stage at the goniometer's centre.
Door closed and locked: the X-ray interlock lets the 600 W tube switch on.
Scan, drawn see-through: the tube stays put, the sample tilts by theta and the detector sweeps 2theta from 10 to 90 degrees.
The detector parks, the door opens again and the sample comes out.
Door shut. At 722 mm tall the MiniFlex just fits a tray: Kardex allows 727.5 mm.
